name: Current Route Block
description: A block that displays information about the current route.
project_description:
This Drupal module provides a block that displays information about the current route on a page. It is especially designed to assist backend developers and site administrators in identifying the active route. This can make it notably easier to modify or comprehend the workflow that utilizes the route. By integrating this block onto a page, backend developers can quickly access route details, ultimately streamlining the website development process.

 Features 
 Add a new layout block to display the current page route details.

 Post-Installation 
 To view the block, add it to the block layout.
